landscape.label: What Is AEO?
landscape.title: What is AEO?
landscape.lead: Making your business easy for AI assistants to understand, trust and recommend.
landscape.say: That's where AEO comes in. Answer Engine Optimization is the work of making your business easy for AI assistants to understand, trust, and recommend, so when someone asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, or Google's AI Overviews, your business is in the answer. You'll also hear it called GEO, AI SEO, or LLM SEO.

landscape.note: You still need SEO: the two work together.
landscape.say: How is that different from SEO? SEO is about ranking in a list of ten blue links, with keywords and backlinks. AEO is about getting named in the answer itself, with consistent facts, specific reviews, clear answers, and trusted mentions. And people search differently: not "plumber Ankeny," but "who can fix my water heater in Ankeny today?" You still need SEO. The two work together.

landscape.label: Why It Matters for Trades
landscape.title: Why blue-collar businesses can't skip it
landscape.say: Why does this matter so much for blue-collar businesses? Because your jobs are urgent and local. When a pipe bursts, a furnace quits, hail hits a roof, or a breaker won't reset, people want one answer, fast. AI names only a few businesses, and if yours isn't one of them, you don't get the call, no matter how good your work is.

landscape.say: So how does AI pick a contractor? It looks for five signals. Consistent listings: your name, hours, and address match on Google, Bing, Apple Maps, and Yelp. Specific reviews that mention the job and the town. An answer-ready website. Structured data that tells AI your services and service area. And trusted mentions in local press, guides, and directories.
